public.query: The tiger does not visit the cow.
rules: If something is blue then it needs the tiger.
If something is nice and it visits the tiger then the tiger is blue.
If something needs the cow and it visits the cow then it is not blue.
If something needs the cow and the cow visits the tiger then the tiger does not need the rabbit.
If something needs the tiger and it visits the cow then it does not visit the rabbit.
If something needs the tiger then it visits the tiger.
If the tiger needs the mouse then the mouse needs the rabbit.
